'''Secret Whales''' is a [[:category:Vietnam|Vietnamese]] team formed in December 2024 following a partnership between ⁠⁠[[Team Whales]] and [[Team Secret]]. <ref name=LCP>{{cite web |url=https://teamsecret.gg/blogs/league-of-legends/team-secret-x-team-whales-union-announcement|title=Team Secret x Team Whales Union Announcement|publisher=[[Team Secret]]|date=2024-12-06}}</ref>
